name: @southleft/al-react
description: The React powered design system for web applications
//type: See the note of the same name in @southleft/al-web-components. tsc emits ESM here (`module: esnext`), so dist/*.js is ESM and must be declared as such. plop/plop-config was renamed to .cjs for this.

scripts.build: pnpm exec del-cli dist && tsc && node scripts/copy-dist-assets.mjs

//peerDependencies: react/react-dom are PEERS, not dependencies. They were plain `dependencies` until now, which let a consumer's install resolve a SECOND copy of React under node_modules/@southleft/al-react — two react instances in one tree means `Invalid hook call` and a dead context/reconciler boundary, and npm would never warn because the constraint was satisfied locally. They stay in devDependencies below so this workspace still builds and tests on its own.
author: Southleft, LLC
